body.x: CES(Consumer Electronic Show) 2014 hosted by CEA has been closed in Las Vegas, USA.
'Golla' Northern European style brand displayed three different concept, 'Original, On the Road, Air' of its new lineup in its display booth, which caught the eyes of foreign reporters on show floor.

Golla plans to expand the unique IT fashion market with keywords; Original, Outdoor, Woman, etc as unveiling its new product in Korea. New camera bags for mirrorless & SLR cameras, accessory for tablet PC and mores are expected to be launched in response to recent changing market in digital device

The Golla story started in the early 90’s in a small Finnish town. Two ambitious brothers incorporated their strong sense of design by creating small functional items from rubber and plastic, which were sold around the world and even appeared in the MoMa gift shop in New York. Golla was honored by Finnish president as a entrepreneur of the year and has launched over 100 countries across the globe.

CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in a wide range of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees over 150 countries came to the show.
